public_rationale: Contemporary approaches had important failures, but also measurable successes. Structural generalization tests sharply separated weaker sequence models from successful compositional parsers, and LaMDA improved dialogue performance. These findings defeat a reading that nothing useful was working. They do not settle the contextual claim that general interpretation and expression of meaning had not been achieved.
limitations: The selected tasks cover components of language competence.
Progress does not by itself establish completion of the stated goal.
Observed failures do not establish that every contemporary approach failed.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Current machine approaches to language acquisition are not really working.

statement.excerpt: We don’t know how kids do it; we do know that what we are doing with machines currently isn’t really working.
statement.document_title: Learning Language is Harder Than You Think

from_speaker: what we are doing with machines currently
our_interpretation: Working refers to the immediately preceding goal of interpreting sentences and expressing intended meanings with general language competence.
The claim is not read as denying every useful application or every improvement on a language benchmark.
The separate statement about how children learn is outside the normalized proposition being assessed.
Currently refers to approaches existing on July 20, 2022. With no regular reporting cycle, I use current-year evaluations through that date.
criteria.support_condition: Convergent evaluations establish that contemporary approaches failed to achieve reliable general interpretation and expression of meanings.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A contemporary approach demonstrably achieves reliable general interpretation and expression of meanings across varied unfamiliar situations.

evidence.explanation: The comparison identifies a substantial weakness in sequence-to-sequence models while showing that other machine approaches succeed on the same structural tests. Neither result establishes general bidirectional language competence.

evidence.locator: Section 2, Related work, comparison with scaling studies
evidence.explanation: LaMDA's evaluations report improvements in dialogue quality, safety, and factual grounding, while retaining gaps from humans on some measures. This establishes progress without demonstrating the full language-acquisition goal.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: A representative evaluation of July 2022 approaches against an explicit standard for reliable general comprehension and meaning-preserving generation.
